title: WorldObservation
description: One camera observation tied to the measured robot state that produced it. Validation authority: autonomy/perception/world_observation.py validate_observation(). Every enum, const, pattern, required list and closed property set in this file is pinned to the Python constant by autonomy/tests/test_world_observation.py. The validator additionally enforces cross-field rules this file cannot state: camera.role equals the role named in observation_id; timestamp_utc is a real calendar time; cube_held 'yes' goes with gripper_state 'holding'; robot_state.source, state_image_association and joint_stability_max_delta_deg agree with the two stored joint reads; camera_pose.status and missing_calibration are bounded by calibration.items; a calibrated wrist pose needs STATIC_CONFIRMED; T_base_camera is null unless the status is calibrated and has bottom row 0,0,0,1; raw_frame_path is relative and present exactly when the capture produced a valid frame; no raw device path anywhere; no NaN or Infinity. Raw frames and records stay in ignored local directories.

observation_id.description: becomes the record and frame file name; the embedded time is UTC

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 time the frame was kept, with an explicit UTC designator

identity_fingerprint.description: hash prefix of the stable device identity; never the identity itself

image_orientation.description: which image this is, e.g. direct-v4l-unrotated; calibration applies per orientation and resolution

raw_frame_path.description: relative path inside the observation directory; null only when the capture produced no valid frame

measured_joints_deg.description: measured (never commanded) joints read immediately before the capture; degrees, motor-reading convention; gripper in gripper units

measured_joints_post_capture_deg.description: same joints read immediately after the capture; null when there was no second read

joint_stability_max_delta_deg.description: largest difference between the two joint reads; null when they cannot be compared

state_image_association.description: STATIC_CONFIRMED and MOVED_DURING_CAPTURE are measured facts from the two joint reads; STATIC_UNCONFIRMED means there was no comparable second read, so neither may be claimed

T_base_camera.description: 4x4 homogeneous camera pose in BASE_FRAME (meters); null unless the calibration inventory supplies the extrinsics

missing_calibration.description: the required calibration items that calibration.items reports MISSING

items.description: the status of EVERY required calibration item; the three statuses are never collapsed

coverage_basis.description: how far the coverage label can be trusted, e.g. NOMINAL_TOOL_AXIS_UNCALIBRATED

lifecycle.description: the camera open/settle/capture/close record for this observation

atlas_annotation.description: operator-supplied ground truth for the observability atlas; every field is manual and optional
